solution: Working together, the money goes in the ratio of the work each does in a day. Work = LCM(27, 48) = 432 units: X 16, Y 9 a day, ratio 16 : 9. Y's share = ₹11700 × 9/25 = ₹4212.

solutionHi: साथ काम करने पर पैसा प्रतिदिन के काम के अनुपात में बँटता है। काम = 432 इकाई: X 16, Y 9 प्रतिदिन, अनुपात 16 : 9। Y का हिस्सा = ₹11700 × 9/25 = ₹4212।

question: A and B can do a work in 36 days, B and C in 42 days, and C and A in 84 days. In how many days can A alone finish it?
solution: Work = LCM(36, 42, 84) = 252 units. Pairs do 7, 6 and 3 a day; added, that is twice all three: 16, so all three do 8 a day. A = 8 − (B + C) = 8 − 6 = 2 a day. A alone: 252 ÷ 2 = 126 days.
questionHi: A और B एक काम 36 दिन में, B और C 42 दिन में, तथा C और A 84 दिन में कर सकते हैं। A अकेला उसे कितने दिन में पूरा करेगा?
solutionHi: काम = LCM(36, 42, 84) = 252 इकाई। जोड़े प्रतिदिन 7, 6 और 3 करते हैं; जोड़ने पर तीनों का दोगुना: 16, अतः तीनों 8 प्रतिदिन। A = 8 − 6 = 2 प्रतिदिन। A अकेला: 252 ÷ 2 = 126 दिन।

question: A can do a work in 23 days and B in 37 days. Working together they finish it and get ₹13800. What is B's share?
solution: Working together, the money goes in the ratio of the work each does in a day. Work = LCM(23, 37) = 851 units: A 37, B 23 a day, ratio 37 : 23. B's share = ₹13800 × 23/60 = ₹5290.

solutionHi: साथ काम करने पर पैसा प्रतिदिन के काम के अनुपात में बँटता है। काम = 851 इकाई: A 37, B 23 प्रतिदिन, अनुपात 37 : 23। B का हिस्सा = ₹13800 × 23/60 = ₹5290।

question: 1 men and 1 women can do a piece of work in 4 days, while 1 men and 3 women can do it in 2 days. In how many days can 5 men and 3 women do it?
solution: 4(1M + 1W) = 2(1M + 3W) gives M : W = 1 : 1. With a man = 1 and a woman = 1 units a day, work = 4 × 2 = 8 units. 5 men and 3 women do 8 a day: 8 ÷ 8 = 1 days.
questionHi: 1 आदमी और 1 औरतें एक काम 4 दिन में कर सकते हैं, जबकि 1 आदमी और 3 औरतें उसे 2 दिन में कर सकते हैं। 5 आदमी और 3 औरतें उसे कितने दिन में करेंगे?
solutionHi: 4(1M + 1W) = 2(1M + 3W) से M : W = 1 : 1। आदमी = 1, औरत = 1 इकाई प्रतिदिन लें: काम = 4 × 2 = 8 इकाई। 5 आदमी और 3 औरतें 8 प्रतिदिन: 8 ÷ 8 = 1 दिन।

solution: Work = 154 units. P does 7 a day: in 11 days 77 units, i.e. 77/154 of the work. P's share = ₹20100 × 77/154 = ₹10050. (Q takes 7 days for the rest.)

question: X can do a work in 22 days and Y in 58 days. Working together they finish it and get ₹22200. What is X's share?
solution: Working together, the money goes in the ratio of the work each does in a day. Work = LCM(22, 58) = 638 units: X 29, Y 11 a day, ratio 29 : 11. X's share = ₹22200 × 29/40 = ₹16095.

question: 14 men earn ₹189000 in 18 days. In how many days will 3 men earn ₹33750 at the same rate?
solution: One man earns 189000 ÷ (14 × 18) = ₹750 a day, so 3 men earn 2250 a day. 33750 ÷ 2250 = 15 days.

question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 18, 27 and 54 days respectively. In how many days will they finish it working together?

question: Pipes A and B can fill a water tank in 21 and 39 hours, and pipe C can empty it in 14 hours. A and B are opened on an empty tank, and C is opened 2 hours later. In how many hours from the start will it be full?
solution: The tank = LCM(21, 39, 14) = 546 units. First 2 hours: 2 × 40 = 80. Then 40 − 39 = 1 an hour for the remaining 466: 466 hours. Total 2 + 466 = 468 hours.

question: X alone can do a job in 16 days and Y alone in 28 days. With Z's help they finish it in 8 days, and Z is paid ₹6900 for his part. What was the whole job worth?
solution: Work = LCM(16, 28, 8) = 112 units. All three do 14 a day; Z does 14 − 7 − 4 = 3, so 24 of the 112 units in 8 days. 24/112 of the job = ₹6900, so the whole job = 6900 × 112 ÷ 24 = ₹32200.
